# BIMLog

> BIMLog is an accountable construction-coordination platform for AEC teams. It connects controlled project records, RFIs, submittals, transmittals, change orders, files, reports, and Navisworks viewpoints in one traceable project history.

## Public product information

- [Product overview](https://bimlog.app/)
- [Features](https://bimlog.app/features)
- [Pricing](https://bimlog.app/pricing)
- [About BIMLog](https://bimlog.app/about)
- [Contact](https://bimlog.app/contact)

## Security and agent access

BIMLog customer, company, project, document, and job data is private. It is not public crawl content and must not be inferred from this file. Authenticated integrations and agent tools require a current BIMLog user session, company and project authorization, applicable role permissions, provider approval, and server-side audit controls. This file documents public product information only; it is not an API credential, authorization grant, tool manifest, or proof of indexing.
